subject: ventures/league-schedule-generator
professional: a rec-league coordinator / sports scheduler who builds round-robin seasons and runs social padel/pickleball Americano nights; first checks: does every pair meet exactly once per leg with nobody twice in a round, are home/away splits within one and breaks at the known minimum, do byes rotate evenly in odd leagues, do standings tie-breaks follow the stated point system, and does the night scorer rank players fairly after sit-outs

evidence.correctness: Own checker (/tmp/claude-0/lsg/check.mjs, uses none of the subject's validators or countBreaks) over roundRobin for n = 2..24, single and double: every pair meets exactly once per leg (and once each way in the double), no team twice in a round, every team placed or on the bye, n-1 / n rounds per leg, home/away spread <= 1 (0 in the double), every team exactly one bye per leg when n is odd: 0 failures. Breaks: single even n gives n-2 (4 for 6, 6 for 8, 22 for 24), the de Werra lower bound; odd single 0 even counting across byes. All 31 stored whist designs (4..64, every 4k and 4k+1, incl. the new 52 and 57) develop to rounds where every pair partners exactly once and opposes exactly twice: 0 failures. Swiss (8 players, stronger seed always wins, 3 rounds): no rematch, a unique 3/3 leader, Dutch top-half v bottom-half pairing in each score group, score and Buchholz match my recount. Bracket seedOrder(16)/(8) separates 1/2 to halves and 1/4, 2/3 to quarters as standard. One-day timetable 8 teams, 2 courts, 30+5 min: 28 games, 14 slots, finish 17:05 by hand. Americano night scorer, 6 players, games to 24, 6 rounds: points for/against/diff/wins match my tally; the 'average' sit-out credit is computed from the average already rounded to 0.1, so Dee 63 pts in 4 games, 2 sit-outs gets 31.6 not 31.5 (double rounding). Head-to-head with set scoring still awards plain win points in the mini-table: A and B level on 7 FIVB points, A beat B 3-2, 3-2, lost 0-3; under the league's own 2/1 rule B leads the mini-table 5-4 but the tool ranks A first (h2h points 6 v 3). Core engines right; two tie-break/scoring departures in edge settings, so 3.
evidence.completeness: Claimed features checked end to end via module calls: single/double round robin, byes, one-day timetable and rest mode, standings with h2h and set scoring, Swiss pairings and standings, single-elimination bracket with byes to top seeds, Americano (whist and greedy), Mexicano draw, night scorer (setScore, leaderboard, CSV, share-link round trip via encodeNight/decodeNight tests). 777 tests over 48 files exercise divisions, bowling, carry-over, exports, server features. served-copy reports no placeholder origin. No stubs found on the paths read; README admits some exports were never tried against a live Google/Outlook account.
evidence.verification: node --test '*.test.mjs' from the subject: 777 pass, 0 fail, 7 min 23 s. Five seeded mutants via quality_mutate.py: goals-for tie-break reversed (calc.mjs:2781) now CAUGHT (it survived in the 2026-11-07 and -08 audits); circle-method home/away alternation removed (calc.mjs:375) CAUGHT; FIVB 3-2 loser point removed (calc.mjs:2730) CAUGHT; average sit-out credit off by one sit-out (night.mjs:156) CAUGHT; leaderboard tie-break order diff/wins swapped (night.mjs:160) SURVIVED. 4 of 5 caught. night.test.mjs:72 asserts credit == the rounded avg, i.e. pins the author's own formula rather than an independent value.
evidence.craft: Read calc.mjs (roundRobin 366-389, countBreaks 489-503, standings 2716-2786, swiss 3594-3730, americano 3786-3880), night.mjs (all 254 lines), whist.mjs head, eval/browser-click-single.mjs. night.mjs is clean: immutable updates, input clamping, CSV formula guard, checkNight on links. But calc.mjs has grown from 3,197 to 4,149 lines and README.md is 4,920 lines of experiment log; divisions.mjs 2,212. The h2h mini-table duplicates the points logic instead of sharing the set-scoring branch, which is how the set-scoring bug persists. eval/browser-click-single.mjs:49 still waits for a selector that is already visible.
evidence.claims: README.md:6 and :18 claim 'the minimum possible breaks' / 'the fewest possible home/away breaks' for single or double. True for single (n-2). For the default double the tool mirrors leg one: 12 breaks at 6 teams, 18 at 8; reversing leg one's round order for leg two (each pair still once home, once away) gives 8 and 12 = 2(n-2) (/tmp/claude-0/lsg/inverted.mjs). The guide discloses 3(n-2) for a mirrored double, the headline does not. README:231 still says `node --test` runs the suite (Node 22 needs '*.test.mjs'). Backed: sit-out credit eval figure 26.7% (eval/sit-out-credit.txt:12), whist sizes 'every 4k or 4k+1 up to 64' (recomputed), disclaimer and independence notice and usage opt-out on americano-night.html:138-141. The sitemap relative URLs and github.io links in llms.txt flagged in earlier audits are rewritten at deploy (served-copy: absolute marisstella.app URLs, 0 github.io), so source-only.
evidence.fitness: A coordinator can paste teams, build a dated single/double season with byes, blackouts, courts and time slots, export CSV/ICS, record results and get standings, seed a bracket, and run an Americano night from one phone with live table and share link. A double-RR league that cares about breaks gets 50% more than necessary with no option to pick an inverted second leg except via the carry-over search; a volleyball league using h2h can get a tie resolved against its own point system.
evidence.domain: Circle method with built-in alternation at the n-2 minimum, mirrored double at the mirrored minimum 3n-6 (de Werra 1981), whist designs verified, Dutch-style Swiss with Buchholz/Sonneborn-Berger, standard bracket seeding: a scheduler would sign these off. Departures: no inverted/French-scheme second leg option on the default path; h2h mini-table ignores FIVB 3-2/2-1 match points; Swiss Buchholz ignores byes (FIDE uses a virtual opponent), minor; one-day timetable plays rounds in strict order so 7 teams on 2 courts take 14 slots where 11 suffice (documented rule).

Persists from the 2026-11-10 audit

Head-to-head mini-table ignores setScoring: plain win points inside the tied group, so with FIVB 3-2 = 2/1 a team the league's own points put ahead (B 5 v 4) is ranked below (tool A 6 v B 3). Persists from 2026-11-07, -08
Americano 'average' sit-out credit multiplies the average already rounded to 0.1 by sit-outs (63 pts / 4 games, 2 sit-outs: 31.6, exact 31.5); can flip a near tie. The test pins credit == rounded avg
Night leaderboard tie-break order (total, then difference, then wins) is untested: swapping difference and wins left night.test.mjs green

verdict: Earlier defects: the goals-for tie-break mutation that survived on 2026-11-07/08 is now caught (fixed); the bye-resets-breaks convention is now stated in countBreaks and the guide (fixed); sitemap/llms.txt host issues are source-only (served copy clean); the h2h-ignores-set-scoring bug, the unqualified 'minimum possible breaks' headline for a double, the README test command, the stale browser-eval wait and the monolith all persist. The core engines are right by an independent checker: every pair once per leg, nobody twice a round, even byes, home/away within one and n-2 breaks for every even single round robin from 2 to 24 teams, all 31 whist designs exact, Swiss without rematches. The new Americano scorer tallies correctly, with a small double-rounding in the average sit-out credit and an untested tie-break order. 777 tests pass and 4 of 5 seeded bugs are caught. Claims scores 2 (the double-round-robin headline is 50% off what an inverted leg achieves) and craft 2, so it does not meet the bar; it is finished (completeness 3).
